inputs.name: registerUnitsCommand.program
inputs.description: Commander `Command` instance on which `registerUnitsCommand` installs the `units` subtree; required when wiring this CLI group and must expose the Commander `.command()` API.

outputs.name: registerUnitsCommand
outputs.description: No value is returned; the function attaches the Units command tree to the supplied program during CLI registration.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: An expected CLI error raised when the `units check` action finds one or more report errors; its message is those strings joined with newline separators.
